public_body: Saugus Cable Television Station Board Of Directors
overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by holding meetings at a studio whose ramp was not ADA-compliant and by missing complaint-response deadlines, but found no deliberation outside a meeting and no violation from the selectman's attendance.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged that during a July 14, 2014 swearing-in and studio tour, the Board deliberated on financial matters about the studio's operation.
allegations.key_passage: Absent evidence to the contrary, we credit the public body's account of events and find no violation of the law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a Board of Selectmen member's attendance at an October 6, 2014 Board meeting violated the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: Because there was no communication between or among a quorum of the Board of Selectmen on October 6, 2014, we find there was no improper deliberation and no violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged meetings held on July 30 and October 6, 2014 in the studio were not accessible to people with disabilities, as the ADA requires.
allegations.key_passage: the ramp in its current condition does not meet ADA requirements.

allegations.summary: The Board's responses to the August and November 2014 complaints came well after the 14-business-day deadline; the AG raised this itself.
allegations.key_passage: Again, the Board did not respond until January 29, 2015.

remedy: Hold all future meetings in a location that complies with the requirements of the ADA.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: to hold all future meetings in a location that complies with the requirements of the ADA.
